name: solve-challenge v1 - submit the solve for a funded challenge

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: The store posts challenge.ready (schema 1) here. Authentication is the HMAC in Verify Request, not an n8n credential, so nothing is attached. Raw Body must stay on.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Paste the real values here after import - N8N_SOLVE_CHALLENGE_KEY: the store's solve publisher identity, compared with X-ArabUT-Key; N8N_SOLVE_CHALLENGE_SECRET: HMAC secret of the incoming request, 32+ characters, same value as on the store; N8N_FULFILLMENT_KEY: X-ArabUT-Key the store expects on the placement report - the same value ship-coins uses; N8N_FULFILLMENT_SECRET: HMAC secret of the placement report, 32+ characters, same value as on the store; FFT_API_USER: FuTTransfer API user; FFT_API_KEY: FuTTransfer API key; ARABUT_STORE_URL: the store origin - ships filled in, change only for a staging store. Keep "Include Other Input Fields" and "Include Binary" on.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  "apiUser": $('Config').first().json.FFT_API_USER,
  "apiKey": $('Config').first().json.FFT_API_KEY,
  "setID": $('Validate Set').first().json.setID,
  "account": [$('Validate Set').first().json.eaEmail],
  "accountType": "customer",
  "timesToSolve": $('Validate Set').first().json.timesToSolve || 1,
  "fillSBC": 0,
  "customName": "Order #" + $('Validate Set').first().json.orderId + " - " + $('Validate Set').first().json.sbcName,
  "clubItemHandling": "exclude",
  "consoleLock": 1
}) }}

nodes.name: Report Placement
nodes.notes: Runs once per challenge. Signed with N8N_FULFILLMENT_KEY / N8N_FULFILLMENT_SECRET from the Config node, the store-side credential of the placement endpoint (docs/api/n8n-fulfillment-v1.md).

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: A throw anywhere before this node answers 500, which the store treats as "retry later" on its backoff.
